title: 민주화운동기념사업회법 시행령 / queue:ADDENDUM:24425:20130323:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Security and Public Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 24425, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That among Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 6 of these Addenda, amendments to Presidential Decrees that had been promulgated before this Decree entered into force but had not yet reached their enforcement dates shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 through 5
Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (55) Omitted.

(56) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Korea Democracy Foundation shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2, subparagraph 3, "Minister of the Interior and Safety" shall be replaced with "Minister of Security and Public Administration".

(57) through (129) Omitted.
